offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai) — Search the web and convert results to LLM-friendly text
offerings.pricing: 按 token 计费；'Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens'；标准档 $50 / 0.050 per 1M tokens，Premium 档 $500 / 0.045 per 1M tokens
offerings.price_basis: Standard key（Prototype Development $50 包，$0.050/1M tokens），每次搜索按官网固定 10,000 tokens 机械换算
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens（Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, 非商业使用 CC-BY-NC）
offerings.output_type: SERP 搜索结果：'search the web and return the top five results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text'
offerings.note: In Search mode returns a list of five entries each with URL, title, content, timestamp；Premium 档同口径约 $0.45/千次；RPM: 无 key 100, paid 1000 RPM；2025年5月6日起新定价模型
